quarterly_data.signal: On September 30, 2026 Vicor raised its Q3 sequential growth guidance again, from more than 20% to more than 30%, in view of increased royalties from the previously announced first non-exclusive license to Vertical Power Delivery (VPD). The licensee is not named and no dollar figure is given.
